# What does this hydroseeding job really cost, and what should you bid?

> Free hydroseeding bid calculator: enter seed, mulch, water, tank size, crew, travel and equipment and see the cost and profit of a job, the price per 1,000 sq ft for your target margin, and the season result. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
